UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

_PAD_X

Side/vertical bleed (css px) around the title box — embers need room, and the smoke wander (~30px lateral drift over a puff's life) must not slice at the canvas edge.

_PAD_TOP

Top bleed (css px) — the smoke plume climbs at up to ~90px/s with a life up to 3.2s (~250px of headroom needed) before it thins out; the canvas must hold the whole column so the plume dissipates instead of slicing at the canvas edge.

_PAD_BOTTOM

Bottom bleed (css px) — the front ignites at the baseline edge.

_JAG_RATIO

Jagged-edge amplitude as a fraction of the paper height — a small organic waver on top of the per-letter speed spread.

_COL_SPEED_MIN

Per-letter burn-speed range — each glyph bucket burns between ~55% and ~145% of the base rate, so letters vanish at visibly different moments while all still finish inside the description's draw time.

_COL_SPEED_SPAN

Random speed spread above the minimum — v lands in 0.7..2.0×.

_SCORCH_RATIO

Scorch-band height below the burn front (fraction of letter height).

_BAND_MIN

Scorch-band minimum height in device px (tiny letters still char visibly).

_BAND_ALPHA

Opacity of the char band laid over ink just above the front.

_GLOW_ALPHA

Opacity of the additive ember wash hugging the live front.

_FRONT_STEP

X stride for tracing a letter's jagged front polygon (device px).

_BURN_MS_MIN

Seconds the front spends travelling the paper. Falls under desc time.

_BURN_MS_MAX

Burn duration ceiling — long descriptions cap here, never run on.

_DESC_CHAR_MS

Per-char desc draw estimate (ms) — mirrors the 8ms char delay + draw.

_DESC_TAIL_MS

Trailing draw allowance (ms) after the description's last char.

_P_MAX

Particle budget — hard cap on live embers + flecks.

_SPAWN_PER_S

Ember spawn per second along the front while it burns.

_CHAR_FRACTION

Fraction of spawns that are dark char flecks (rest are embers).

_EMBER_LIFE_MIN

Particle lifetime bounds (seconds).

_EMBER_LIFE_MAX

Ember lifetime ceiling — sparks die well before the front finishes.

_FLECK_LIFE_MIN

Fleck lifetime floor — char flecks outlast embers (they tumble).

_FLECK_LIFE_MAX

Fleck lifetime ceiling (seconds).

_EMBER_VY_MIN

Ember upward velocity bounds (canvas px/s).

_EMBER_VY_MAX

Ember upward velocity ceiling — the fastest sparks outrun the front.

_EMBER_VX

Ember sideways drift bound (canvas px/s).

_FLECK_VY

Fleck launch velocity + gravity pull (canvas px/s, px/s²).

_FLECK_VX

Fleck sideways drift bound (canvas px/s).

_FLECK_G

Gravity accelerating flecks + rebuild deposits downward (px/s²).

_DEPOSIT_VY

Rebuild deposit launch speed (canvas px/s) — motes leave the empty zone drifting down gently, then _FLECK_G accelerates the fall.

_EMBER_SIZE

Particle size bounds in device px.

_FLECK_SIZE

Fleck size bound — char scraps read bigger than ember sparks.

_ALPHA_STRIDE

Byte offset of the alpha channel inside a getImageData pixel quad.

_INK_ALPHA_MIN

Alpha floor for "has ink" — anti-aliased feather below ~12% is ignored.

_IGNITE_DELAY

Max ignition delay, as a fraction of total progress — letters catch fire anywhere in the first ~fifth of the burn.

_BURN_END

Progress at which the slowest letter finishes — the last glyph ashes out just before the description's final chars land, never after.

_GLOW_RATIO

Ember glow band height, as a share of letter height.

_REBUILD_RATIO

Rebuild speed on un-hover — the un-burn replays the consume front downward at this fraction of the burn duration, so rebuilding the title reads quicker than burning it away while staying visible.
